author: Animalogic
description:
The greatest animal on land. The African Elephant. These beauties have moved from the African savanna to southern California to teach us about their biology. This knowledge is being used to help save wild elephants. What we learn here at Elephant Valley might change how we see elephants forever. This is the elephant of the future.
